meta.description: Gives the paths that pass through their own blend in hyphae_to_mesh, in place of its blend: crisp ridges next to a soft cap. Every path of the nodes that made them gets it, the other paths keep the blend of hyphae_to_mesh.

plant.description: The paths, they pass through unchanged

blend.description: How far, in path radii, these paths join their neighbours into one surface. Low keeps them crisp and apart, high blends them softly. A lone path keeps its radius at any value. Where two values meet, the lower one decides most.
